name: BibCite Footnotes Article with Citations
description: Demo/example submodule of BibCite Footnotes: installs a fully configured content type, text format, editor and fields showing an in-text-references + works-cited setup.
project_description: Example content type and text format to demonstrate a fully-configured Reference Footnotes setup. Ships (config/install): the 'Article with References' node type (bibcite_fn_article_references) with a 'Works Cited' entity-reference field targeting bibcite_reference (Inline Entity Form - complex widget), plus body/image/tags fields; the 'Basic HTML with References' text format enabling the filter_reference_footnotes filter; and matching editor, form-display and view-display config. Parent project: BibCite Footnotes.
